group.event.liveCreditsUntitled.description: Activity line in a project's channel: a change was approved and is now in use. Used when the change has no title. {{credits}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, naming who built, backed and shaped it, for example 'Built by evan, backed by alice and bob.'

group.event.wentLive.description: Activity line in a project's channel: a change was approved and is now in use. {{title}} is the change's title and starts the sentence. No final full stop.

group.event.wentLiveTally.description: Activity line in a project's channel: a change was approved and is now in use. {{title}} is the change's title and starts the sentence. {{tally}} is the vote tally as the server wrote it, for example 2/3 (votes in favour out of votes needed); it is not a plain count, so the word for votes does not change with it. No final full stop.

group.event.wentLiveUntitled.description: Activity line in a project's channel: a change was approved and is now in use. Used when the change has no title. No final full stop.

group.event.wentLiveUntitledTally.text: A change went live with {{tally}} votes
group.event.wentLiveUntitledTally.description: Activity line in a project's channel: a change was approved and is now in use. Used when the change has no title. {{tally}} is the vote tally as the server wrote it, for example 2/3 (votes in favour out of votes needed); it is not a plain count, so the word for votes does not change with it. No final full stop.

group.event.tail.earlier.text: · on an earlier version, not counted
group.event.tail.earlier.description: Muted note after 'Voted yes' or 'Voted no' on an activity line: the vote was cast on an earlier version of the change and no longer counts. Keep the middle dot first; lower case, it continues the line.

group.event.tail.tally.description: Muted note at the end of an activity line saying a change is live. {{tally}} is the vote tally as the server wrote it, for example 2/3 (votes in favour out of votes needed); it is not a plain count, so the word for votes does not change with it.

group.event.open.description: Tooltip of an activity line about a proposed change in a project's channel: clicking it opens that change's page. Open is a verb; 'change' is a noun.

group.names.next.description: Joins people's usernames into a list, as in 'alice, bob and carol'. {{names}} is the names listed so far and {{name}} the next one, which is not the last. Only the punctuation between them is translated.

group.names.last.description: Ends a list of people's usernames, as in 'alice and bob' or 'alice, bob and carol'. {{names}} is the names listed so far and {{name}} is the last one.

group.credits.built.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it.

group.credits.builtBacked.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{backers}} is the list of usernames of the people who voted for it, already joined.

group.credits.builtShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{shapers}} is the list of usernames of the people whose comments shaped it, already joined.

group.credits.builtBackedShaped.text: Built by {{author}}, backed by {{backers}}, shaped by {{shapers}}.
group.credits.builtBackedShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it; {{shapers}} is the joined list of those whose comments shaped it.

group.credits.backed.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when the builder is not named. {{backers}} is the list of usernames of the people who voted for it, already joined.

group.credits.backedShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when the builder is not named. {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it; {{shapers}} is the joined list of those whose comments shaped it.

group.credits.shaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when only the people whose comments shaped it are named. {{shapers}} is the list of their usernames, already joined.

group.weekly.title.description: Heading of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, and the card's one-line text. {{app}} is the project's name.

group.weekly.titleNoApp.description: One-line text of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel when the project's name is not known.

group.weekly.nothingLanded.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel when no change went live this week. 'Landed' means was released.

group.weekly.wentLive_one.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Change' is a noun.

group.weekly.wentLive_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Changes' is a noun.

group.weekly.authorBacked.description: After a change's title on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, following a middle dot. {{author}} is the username of the person who built the change; {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it.

group.weekly.moreLive_one.description: Last line of the list of changes released this week on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes went live that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.moreLive_other.description: Last line of the list of changes released this week on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes went live that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.waiting_one.text: One change is waiting for approval
group.weekly.waiting_one.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes waiting for the community's vote, when there is exactly one. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

group.weekly.waiting_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes waiting for the community's vote. {{count}} is how many.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_one.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_other.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.door.description: Link at the bottom of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: opens the project's Workshop, the tab that lists its changes and requests. Open is a verb; Workshop is the tab's name. Keep the › at the end.

group.attachment.openFullSize.description: Tooltip of a picture attached to a chat message: clicking it opens the picture at full size. {{file}} is the file's name. Open is a verb.

group.attachment.openFullSizeUnnamed.description: Tooltip of a picture attached to a chat message: clicking it opens the picture at full size. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.download.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the download control on a file attached to a chat message. {{file}} is the file's name. Download is a verb.

group.attachment.downloadUnnamed.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the download control on a file attached to a chat message. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.view.description: Tooltip of a Markdown file attached to a chat message: clicking its name opens the file for reading in the side panel. {{file}} is the file's name. View is a verb.

group.attachment.viewUnnamed.description: Tooltip of a Markdown file attached to a chat message: clicking its name opens the file for reading in the side panel. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.previewTitle.description: Tooltip of the Preview link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab, isolated ('sandboxed') so it cannot touch the person's account. {{file}} is the file's name. Open is a verb.

group.attachment.previewTitleUnnamed.description: Tooltip of the Preview link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab, isolated ('sandboxed') so it cannot touch the person's account. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.unnamed.description: Stands where a file's name would be on a chat attachment that has none. Shown alone, as the chip's label. A noun, lower case.

group.attachment.preview.description: Link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab to look at it. A verb here.

group.row.editTitle.description: Tooltip of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message. A verb.

group.row.edit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message.

group.row.savedTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: clicking removes it from their saved items.

group.row.saveTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message: clicking keeps the message in the person's notifications list so they can find it later. Save is a verb.

group.row.unsave.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: removes it from their saved items.

group.row.save.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message: keeps the message in the person's saved items. Save is a verb, to bookmark.

group.row.reactTitle.description: Tooltip of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with. A verb.

group.row.addReaction.description: Accessible name of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with.

group.row.repeated_one.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_one.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.repeated_other.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_other.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.unreadMention.description: Accessible name of the dot before the author of a chat message that mentions the person and that they have not read yet.

group.row.edited.description: Small muted word after a chat message's time when its author changed the message after sending it. Lower case.

group.row.deleted.description: Shown in place of a chat message's content after its author deleted it.

group.specCard.sharedBy.description: Line on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version. Shared is a verb form.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeone.description: Line on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number.

group.specCard.sharedByBuilt.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeoneBuilt.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{built}} is when it was built, already formatted.

group.specCard.sharedByPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR is the usual abbreviation of pull request.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeonePr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{number}} is the pull request's number; keep "PR #".

group.specCard.sharedByBuiltPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR abbreviates pull request.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeoneBuiltPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{built}} is when it was built, already formatted. {{number}} is the pull request's number; keep "PR #".

group.specCard.loading.description: Replaces the label of the 'View full plan' button on a shared plan's card while the plan is being fetched.

group.specCard.view.description: Button on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) shared in a chat: opens the whole plan in the side panel. View is a verb.

group.menu.makeRequest.description: Item in a chat message's menu: asks Homeroom bot to treat the message as a request to build something for the project. 'Request' is a noun.

group.menu.viewThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message already has replies: opens the thread of replies under it.

group.menu.replyInThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message has no replies yet: opens a thread under the message to reply there. Reply is a verb.

group.menu.edit.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: starts editing it.

group.menu.copyText.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies the message's text to the clipboard. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.textCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy text' in a chat message's menu: the message's text is on the clipboard.

group.menu.copyLink.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies a web link that opens the chat at this message. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.linkCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy link to message' in a chat message's menu: the link is on the clipboard.

group.menu.markUnread.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: marks the channel as unread from this message on, so it shows as new again. Mark is a verb.

group.menu.markedUnread.description: Brief notice after 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu: the channel now shows as unread from that message.

group.menu.markUnreadFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu failed. 'This' is the message.

group.menu.delete.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: asks for confirmation, then deletes the message for everyone.

group.menu.deleteFailed.description: Brief notice when deleting the person's own chat message failed.

group.menu.report.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: opens the form that reports the message to the moderators. Report is a verb.

group.menu.block.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: asks for confirmation, then hides that person's messages from the reader. {{username}} is the author's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb.

group.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: asks for confirmation, then hides that person's messages from the reader. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.menu.blockFailed.description: Alert shown when blocking a chat message's author failed and the server gave no reason. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.deleteConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted.

group.deleteConfirm.message.text: Everyone will see “Message deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.
group.deleteConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted. “Message deleted” is the exact text shown where the message was; translate it the same way as that text.

group.deleteConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to delete the person's own chat message. A verb.

group.blockConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before a chat message's author is blocked. {{username}} is that person's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.blockConfirm.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before a chat message's author is blocked. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.blockConfirm.message.text: Their messages in Messages and app discussions will be hidden.
group.blockConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before a person is blocked from a chat message's menu. The second 'Messages' is the name of the Messages tab; 'app discussions' are the projects' channels.

group.blockConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to block a chat message's author. A verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.report.label.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from a chat message. {{username}} is the message author's username; keep the @ before it.

group.report.labelUnknown.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from a chat message. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.sheet.reply.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held on a touch screen: starts a reply to that message. A verb.

group.sheet.unsave.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a saved chat message is pressed and held: removes the message from the person's saved items.

group.sheet.save.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held: keeps the message in the person's saved items. A verb, to bookmark; not saving a form.

group.thread.replies_one.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Reply is a noun.

group.thread.replies_other.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Replies is a noun.

group.thread.noReplies.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat that nobody has replied to.

group.history.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a discussion's messages: fetches the older messages before the ones shown. Load is a verb.

group.composer.replyingToPlatform.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to an automatic line that Homeroom itself posted, such as a change being put up for a vote. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToMessage.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to a message whose author is no longer known. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToSystem.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a chat line that came with no author and shows "System" in the author's place. "@System" is written as it has always been shown.

group.composer.replyingToSomeone.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a shared plan card whose sharer is not known and shows "Someone". "@Someone" is written as it has always been shown.

group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.text: 👋 Say hi, ask a question, or share what you would like to see next in this app.
group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may write. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.text: Messages from the people building this app will show up here.
group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may read but not write.

group.typing.one.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while one other person is typing. {{name}} is their username.

group.typing.several.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while several other people are typing. {{names}} is their usernames, already joined into a list.

group.send.notSentReason.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused. {{reason}} is the server's own complete sentence saying why, for example that the channel has moved or the topic was closed.

group.send.notSentJoin.text: Not sent. Join this project to post here.
group.send.notSentJoin.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person is not a member of the project. Join and post are verbs: become a member, send a message.

group.send.rateLimited_one.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} second.
group.send.rateLimited_one.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimited_other.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
group.send.rateLimited_other.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimitedMoment.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in a moment.
group.send.rateLimitedMoment.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time, and the wait is not known.

group.send.error.description: Brief notice when the chat connection reported an error and gave no explanation of its own.

group.send.notSentError.text: Not sent. Something went wrong. Try again.
group.send.notSentError.description: Brief notice when a chat message could not be delivered because its channel moved or its topic was closed, and the server gave no explanation of its own.

group.systemSender.description: Stands in for the author's name on a chat line that no person wrote, such as an automatic notice, when the project's name is not available. A noun: the platform itself.

group.history.failed.description: Error line in a project's channel when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.readOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box of a discussion thread the person may read but not write in.

group.thread.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of a discussion thread. Reply is a verb.

group.thread.empty.text: No messages yet. Start the thread.
group.thread.empty.description: Line shown in a discussion thread that has no messages. Start is a verb: write the first message.

group.thread.loading.description: Line shown in a discussion thread while its messages are being fetched.

group.thread.failed.description: Error line in a discussion thread when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.unknownAuthor.description: Stands where a person's username is shown on the card under a chat message that previews the newest reply in its thread, when the reply's author is not known. Shown alone in the name's own element; lower case in English, like a username.

group.quote.spec.description: Stands in for the text of a shared plan that has no title, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A plan is the written description of a change.

group.quote.file.description: Stands in for an attached file's name when it has none, after a paperclip, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A noun, lower case.

group.quote.pr.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that came from a pull request, and in a shared plan's subtitle. PR is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number. Keep the # before the number.

group.quote.prUnnumbered.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that came from a pull request whose number is not known.

group.quote.system.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that no person wrote. Lower case, one word: the platform itself.

group.bookmark.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when bookmarking a chat message failed. Save means keep it in the person's saved items.

group.bookmark.unsaveFailed.description: Brief notice when removing a chat message from the person's saved items failed.

group.bot.askFailed.text: Couldn’t ask Homeroom bot just now.
group.bot.askFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Make this a request' on a chat message could not reach Homeroom bot, the product's assistant that builds changes. Keep the name Homeroom bot.

group.row.editedAt.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message. {{when}} is the date and time of the last edit, already formatted, for example Jun 16, 2026, 02:41 PM. Lower case.

group.row.editedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message when the time of the edit is not known. Lower case.

group.edit.notConnected.text: Not connected. Your edit wasn’t sent, so try again in a moment.
group.edit.notConnected.description: Notice beside the Save and Cancel buttons while editing a chat message, when the change could not be sent because the connection is down. 'Edit' is a noun here: the changed message.

group.report.selected.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from the reaction bar of a chat message on a touch screen.

group.attach.tooBig.image.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Images max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.image.description: Error above the chat message box when a picture chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.markdown.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Markdown files max {{kilobytes}} KB.
group.attach.tooBig.markdown.description: Error above the chat message box when a Markdown file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{kilobytes}} is the limit in kilobytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.html.text: "{{file}}" is too big. HTML files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.html.description: Error above the chat message box when an HTML file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.other.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.other.description: Error above the chat message box when a file chosen to attach is over the size limit for files in general. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_one.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_other.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.uploadFailedStatus.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.attach.uploadFailed.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and nothing more is known.

group.attach.stillUploading.description: Notice above the chat message box when Send was pressed while an attached file is still uploading; the message is not sent yet.

group.file.loadFailedStatus.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing. {{file}} is the file's name; {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 404.

group.file.loadFailedStatusUnnamed.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as it has always been shown. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

group.file.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing and nothing more is known.

group.spec.title.description: Title of a shared plan that has no title of its own, on its card in the chat and in the side panel. {{version}} is the plan's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. A plan is the written description of a change.

group.spec.previewTitle.description: Title shown in the side panel's header while a shared plan with no title of its own is being fetched. {{version}} is the plan's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. Lower case.

group.spec.someone.description: Stands in for the username of the person who shared a plan in a chat when it is not known, in 'Shared by …' on the plan's card.

group.spec.gone.text: This plan is no longer available. The sharer may have deleted the session.
group.spec.gone.description: Shown in the side panel when a plan shared in a chat no longer exists. 'The sharer' is the person who shared it; a 'session' is the piece of work with the AI builder that the plan belonged to.

group.spec.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a plan shared in a chat could not be fetched. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.spec.empty.description: Shown in the side panel in place of the content of a shared plan that has no content. Keep the parentheses.

group.spec.error.description: Shown in the side panel when fetching a shared plan failed. {{message}} is the browser's own technical error message.

group.spec.loading.description: Shown in the side panel in place of a shared plan's content while it is being fetched again after the page was reloaded.

group.status.reconnecting.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection to the chat is down and being restored.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_one.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_other.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.ref.byUser.description: Stands in for the title of a proposed change that has none, in the list of changes offered while typing # in a chat message. {{username}} is the username of the person who proposed it. Lower case.

group.botCard.filed.approvedRelease.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approvedReleaseUntit.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.fir.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. The change is the project's first version. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.tit.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.unt.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.topicChannel.empty.description: Line shown in a topic's channel of a project's discussion when nobody has written in it yet. A topic is one of a project's own named channels, such as #onboarding.

group.topicChannel.start.description: Invitation in the middle of a topic's channel when nobody has written in it yet. {{handle}} is the channel's name without its #, for example "onboarding".

group.topicChannel.invite.text: Ideas posted here can become requests.
group.topicChannel.invite.description: Second line of the invitation in the middle of an empty topic channel: says what posting there leads to. A request is something a member asks to have built or fixed.

group.botOffer.failed.description: Toast when pressing Yes or No under one of Homeroom bot's offers in a chat could not be sent, and the server gave no reason of its own.
